name: WiFiProvision
description: Drop-in ESP32 WiFi provisioning: captive-portal soft-AP, network scan, manual entry, up to 10 saved networks with editable priority and delete, and a gzipped portal UI served from LittleFS. Synchronous WebServer, no external dependencies. Works across the whole ESP32 family (classic, S3, C3, H2, ...).
keywords: wifi, esp32, captive-portal, provisioning, wifimanager, littlefs, softap
